summary: Phase 8.3 Rider portal — Backend (14/14 pytest passed) and Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) fully validated. Rider login redirects to /rider/dashboard, dashboard renders all required sections (greeting, online switch with toast, Deliveries/Earnings/Active stats, Active orders, Recent earnings, quick links). /rider/orders tabs (Active/Delivered/All) work and show assigned order ord_c5ecdd32f7e8 on All tab. /rider/earnings shows hero card + Last 14 days bar. /rider/profile shows name, APPROVED status badge, contact, vehicle (bike, MH-12-AB-1234), and Sign out. RBAC: customer is redirected away from /rider/dashboard to /home; admin & customer get 401/403 on /api/rider/me. After mark-delivered, /api/rider/earnings reflects deliveries>=1 (₹25).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from a child component (likely in shared UI like Toast/Pressable wrappers). Non-blocking but should be migrated.
Console warns 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — expected on web preview only; verify on native build.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate any remaining `pointerEvents` props to `style.pointerEvents` to silence Expo SDK deprecation warnings (search for `pointerEvents=` across shared components).
(Nice-to-have) After a rider marks an order delivered, current 'Active' tab on /rider/orders becomes empty; consider auto-switching to 'Delivered' tab or showing a hint.
critical_code_review_comments: drivers.py uses `body: dict` for POST /rider/orders/{order_id}/status — works but consider a Pydantic model for stronger validation.

Dashboard 'useToken' hook re-reads from secure storage on mount only; if a user logs in then immediately enters dashboard, token already exists — current flow works because login completes before navigation. OK.
/api/orders/{order_id}/driver-location correctly enforces ownership/staff role and excludes _id.
seed_data_creation: None (used pre-seeded rider drv_2a5c03fa24 and order ord_c5ecdd32f7e8). The status-flow test marked the order delivered; earnings now reflect 1 delivery / ₹25.

If re-running, status-flow assertions remain idempotent (delivered→delivered still returns 200).
